name: claim1_coast
comment: Claim 1: the lab beats simple ways of using the same budget. Same problem, budget and decision rule; only how proposals are made differs. Compare swarm against single_agent and random_mutation on final confirm loss and time to target. Small default budget; raise generations and seeds for the real run.

arms.name: swarm
arms.comment: The full lab: analyst, closed-book, scout with search (OpenAlex, then arXiv if it fails), engineer, vector memory.

arms.name: single_agent
arms.comment: One model call per proposal sees the description, the incumbent and the error digest and writes the candidate. No roles, search or memory.

arms.name: random_mutation
arms.comment: No model: constants perturbed or one term dropped at random. What the evaluation budget buys without any intelligence.
